data.content:
* * *

## [One of the furniture pieces came…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a4d6faf578411b164a38d2f)
One of the furniture pieces came broken. Unfortunately it is very difficult to reach anyone to talk to.

When they replaced the piece they sent it to my billing address which is in another city, not the address I had it originally sent to. Now I am waiting to hear from someone about when I will receive it. 

As well, it is now on sale? Very annoying.

June 25, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 9, 2026

Hi Trudy,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We're very sorry for the inconvenience you experienced with the damaged item and the shipment of the replacement to the incorrect address. We understand how frustrating that must have been. We see that a member of our Customer Experience team has since assisted you and resolved the matter. We appreciate your patience throughout the process and thank you for giving us the opportunity to make things right.

Lulu and Georgia
